Buddh International Circuit (BUDDH) - survey

India - Indian GP 2011-13 (retired, classic) - theme green - day - clockwise - branch cursor/buddh-survey-b1 (pre-merged: shared-shot-tooling, day-wet-lighting, build-gallery fix) - 2026-10-15 - read-only, no js/css edits. 79 frames, SwiftShader/TLX.

Top findings

  1. Lap origin/start/pit are on the back straight; the built 15 corner groups map onto official T4..T3 (defect 1).
  2. Main grandstand built mirrored with a blank wall at the road (2).
  3. buddh-pit-complex never emitted though 'required' (3).
  4. Road elevation 5.3 m vs official 0-14 m (4).
  5. Sky/overcast/fog lighting: saturated blue, no sky weather response (6).

Gallery: weather x time of day x lap position

Orbit camera az 40 el 22 dist 65 at laps 0, 17, 33, 50, 67, 83 %.

day · dry

Reference. Pure saturated cobalt sky (not the hazy, dust-shifted brief); yellow-green grass; tan flat 'field plates' (runoffApron quads) read as floating boards; 251 black lamp posts with slab heads dominate every foreground. Blank grey wall beside the pit straight is the main grandstand's REAR SHELL facing the track (defect 2).

day · wet

Daytime wet now reads as DAY (muted sky, darker saturated grass, lamp reflections) - the merged day-wet-lighting fix works for buddh. Sky is still blue-violet and weather-agnostic.

day · rain

Grey sky, near-black ground and a dark vignette: reads gloomy-overcast rather than night. Rain streaks barely visible at orbit range. Trees/lamps mirrored on the wet ground.

day · overcast

Sky stays the SAME saturated blue as dry; only the ground dims a little. Overcast has no sky/cloud response on this circuit (lighting preset buddh|day|overcast, js/lighting/presets.js:7115 has cloudCover 0.38 only).

day · fog

Ground haze/mist sheets are visible, but the sky above stays saturated blue so the horizon shows a hard seam instead of dissolving.

day · storm

Darkest day variant: near-black ground, grey sky, thin streaks, fog sheets over fields. Readable as storm; far outfield props vanish entirely.

dusk · dry

Warm amber lamp pools on the dirt verge, olive ground, a thin indigo band of sky. Lamps fire although the def is night:false (dusk gate). Pit slab and grandstand wall read flat pale.

dusk · rain

Grey-violet sky, strong wet reflections of lamp heads, dark ground; the best-looking weather variant of the set.

night · dry

Lamp pools on both verges, black sky, cars lit. Grandstand rear wall is the brightest object (flat lit slab). No dedicated night scenery (def night:false).

night · rain

Halos around lamps, road/kerb reflections; ground essentially black outside the pools. Works well.

dawn · dry

Close to dusk: warm ground haze under a blue band. Only 3 of 6 stations captured.

Code & scenery deep-dive

Everything below is read from js/circuits/scenery/buddh.js (685 lines, 18 numbered blocks), js/circuits/buddh.js (72 lines) and instrumented VM builds (scratch/buddh-*.cjs, not committed).

Def

OSM-stitched ring (ODbL), 91 control points, reverse:false, night:false, theme green, sceneryCoordinates:"racing", terrainOuter:110, furniture.sparse:true, kit (kiosk marshals, wArmco rail, panelled fence, monopole boards, truss gantry). No bridges, banks, hwZones, lineHints or dressingExclusions. Elevation comes only from CircuitElevations.buddh (64 samples). _sceneryShift is undefined, so frac tables are in the def frame and consumed through K().

Scenery structure

  • Block 0 lap spine: one infield guardrail chain (12 m, tucked to 6 m through two pinches) and a 14 m outfield rail all round, 10 marshal posts.
  • Blocks 1-3: pit/grandstand/paddock cluster at 0.005-0.10 (see defects 1-3). Block 2 also paints a dust concourse, 3 parking aprons and 22 parked cars.
  • Blocks 4-16 follow the brief rows in order, using runoffApron as the universal flat-colour primitive because groundPatch/motorhome/backdrop emit invalid geometry on this def (header :36-44).
  • Block 14 'haze': 5 mid ridges at 560 m, 7 mid boxes at 590-710 m, 5 haze ridges at 980 m (22 m), 4 at 1280 m, 8 silhouette boxes - all muted warm grey.
  • Block 18 rural depth: 6 brick kilns (chimney 22-27 m), 18 pylons on three runs, 14+8+9 field/stubble bands, 29 bunds, 13 village boxes, field-boundary trees.
  • Night: no authored night lighting; the engine's 251 lamp posts light at dusk/night.

What the brief gets right and wrong

All 16 brief rows are present in code in order, but they are keyed to the def's lap frame, which is rotated relative to the official layout (defect 1). Local DETAIL claims in docs/tracks/buddh.md §6 (closed pit complex) are false for the shipped build (defect 3). Sourced facts used: ENR 2011 sea-wave roof, Eurosafe cladding, circuit site (16 turns, clockwise, 5.137 km, 900 m main / 1.24 km back straight, 0-14 m elevation, 600 m pit lane, 41 garages, turn-by-turn).

Sources

Not captured / uncertain

  • Exact real start/finish position on the main straight (no photo/map fetched); the 0.66-0.70 estimate is derived from official 'main stretch 900-950 m'. docs/tracks/START-LINES.md lists buddh as unchecked.
  • Official turn directions for T4, T7, T10-12 and T3 are inferred from descriptions (the circuit site gives names, not handedness, for some). The mapping is by sequence, direction, sweep angle and straight lengths; it is strong but is not an OSM-numbered ground truth.
  • Elevation: official 0-14 m is a circuit-site claim; the game profile is SRTM-derived. No independent survey.
  • Views not captured: pit lane in motion, T10-12 parabola up close from the ground, east stands up close at eye level, temple silhouette, map/raster views, GLX/WGX renderers, HUD, real-GPU look (all frames SwiftShader/TLX, 1280x720, orbit az 40 el 22 dist 65, field frozen, weather set after race()).
  • Not captured: storm/overcast/fog/wet at dusk or night; dawn only dry at 3 of 6 stations; no side-by-side with real photographs (no network image access); graph-parity not run.
  • Counts in the inventory are from an instrumented build (API call counts incl. dropped and pre-checked props); the three 'drops from this file' were identified via scenery debug logs.
  • Web fetch of Wikipedia was blocked in this container; facts come from the circuit site (via fetch) and search snippets for FIA/F1Technical/Crash.net.
